evidence.evse_naming_summary: 52 AG-prefixed, floor-coded, two-digit EVSE/space names: 14 first-floor, 19 third-floor, 19 fourth-floor.
evidence.line_to_line_definition: EVSEs are assigned to AB/BC/CA branches at 30/-90/150 degrees; phase currents are Ia=Iab-Ica, Ib=Ibc-Iab, Ic=Ica-Ibc.
evidence.topology_caveat: ACN-Sim network-model defaults are audit evidence, not proof of per-session measured voltage or active power.
